difficulty_notes: Two real bugs each needing two coordinated fixes: (1) idempotency - per-attempt key suffix defeats gateway dedupe on timeout-after-capture, AND check-then-record race on concurrent same-key calls (needs per-key, not global, locking); (2) DST - day window computed as UTC+24h, AND range bucketing by elapsed 24h from range start. Red herring: refund netting is documented behaviour and must stay. Regression cases weighted 0.5.
